media.demoHint: Demo: files are stored only in this browser. Use fictional materials, without personal photos or documents.
media.avatarAccount: Sign in or register to add a profile photo.

booking.invalidDates: Enter valid check-in and check-out dates.
booking.past: Check-in cannot be in the past.
booking.missingRoom: Room not found. Please choose again.
booking.occupied: This room is already booked for those dates. Choose another room.

mobile.offline: No connection. Maps and current availability need internet.
mobile.saveFile: Choose Save to Files or a recipient in the iPhone share menu.
mobile.webAuth: Registration and password recovery are not connected in the app API mode yet. Sign in with an existing account; registration uses the web client on the same server.
mobile.bookingLogin: Sign in to request a booking in the app
mobile.localLogout: You signed out on this device. Server session revocation could not be confirmed.
mobile.localHistory: Your history is currently stored only in this app. Create an account to keep it linked to you.
mobile.staffDemoLocal: Password-free demo. Changes stay in this app only. Real staff accounts connect through the server.
mobile.demoWorkspace: Demo · data stays in this app

pricing.periodHint: Set the room-only price per night. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. The base price applies outside these periods. Periods cannot overlap; existing bookings stay unchanged.
pricing.label: Period name
pricing.invalidPeriods: Check the name, dates and whole-number price for each period. Up to 60 periods are allowed.
pricing.overlap: Price periods for a room cannot overlap.
pricing.childCount: Number of children (included in guest count)
pricing.ageHint: Enter completed years at check-in: 0 for an infant. At least one adult is required. All children count towards room capacity.
pricing.invalidChildren: Enter each child’s age from 0 to 17. At least one guest must be an adult.
pricing.childPolicyHint: This removes only this tariff’s supplement for children aged 0–2. The room price remains payable. Extra beds and separate services are not included.
pricing.preview: Estimated price. The server checks current rates on submission and freezes them in the booking.
pricing.baseRoomPrice: per room per night; the price for your dates is shown below
pricing.childrenAtCheckout: Children’s ages and free child tariffs are applied in the booking form.
pricing.publicPeriodHint: Room price for one night. Dates show the first and last night of each period. Your total for the selected dates and stay option is shown when booking.
pricing.outsidePeriods: Outside these periods: {price} per room per night.

checkout.commissionHelp: The fee is added to accommodation. Only the fee is paid online; accommodation is paid directly to the property on arrival.
checkout.refundReconciliation: Refunds require reconciliation of commission and the resort amount.
checkout.loginRequired: Sign in or register to book.
checkout.holdHint: You have up to 15 minutes to pay. The payment link or check-in time may shorten this window. Follow the timer; refreshing the page does not extend it.
checkout.timeExpired: Payment time has expired. Check the status; select an available room to try again.
checkout.accountHistory: Bookings belonging to your account appear here.

payment.title: Booking payment
payment.kaspiExplanation: First select “Get Kaspi payment link”. Preparation may take about a minute. On your phone, select “Pay in Kaspi”; on a computer, scan the QR using the Kaspi app. Check the recipient and amount before paying. Your booking is confirmed after server verification.
payment.qrInstructions: Open Kaspi on your phone and scan the QR. Do not pay after the timer expires.
payment.qrAlt: QR for paying for this booking in Kaspi
payment.qrUnavailable: Could not display the QR. Open this booking on your phone and select “Pay in Kaspi”.
payment.kaspiUnavailable: Kaspi payment is not connected yet. XPayment access setup is still in progress.
payment.resortUnavailable: Online payment is not enabled for this sanatorium yet. Choose a sanatorium with payment available.
payment.verificationHint: The booking is confirmed after the server verifies payment. Returning to the site does not confirm payment.
payment.cancellationSaved: Booking cancelled. Payment details show the refund status when a refund applies.
payment.sandbox: Test payment · no money is charged
payment.explanation: The amount is fixed in your booking. Payment opens on Halyk’s test page. The server verifies payment before confirming your booking. Official test cards only.
payment.hold: Your room is held for {minutes} more min.
payment.unavailable: Bank payment is unavailable: connection setup or verification is incomplete.
payment.paused: Checks on this page have paused. The server continues reconciliation. You can check again.
payment.noReceipt: The payment service receipt is not available on this page yet.

states.pending: Waiting for payment and bank verification.
states.failed: Payment was not completed. Check its status before trying again.
states.expired: Booking expired or cancelled. Do not pay the old link.
states.reconciliation_required: Bank reconciliation required. Do not pay again.

refunds.submitted: Checking the refund with the payment service.
refunds.succeeded: Refund confirmed by the payment service.
refunds.reconciliation_required: The refund needs reconciliation with the payment service.

payment.xpaymentSandboxExplanation: The test link shows the amount and status. Set the test payment result in the XPayment sandbox dashboard. After a successful simulation, the server verifies the payment and automatically confirms the booking.
payment.waitingHint: The status updates automatically. If you have paid, do not pay again.
payment.readyHint: Open Kaspi and check the recipient and amount.

progress.initial: Pay for your booking in Kaspi

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: All properties, cash transactions, expenses and documents in one workspace.
accounting.scopeHint: All properties are shown. Select a property for its requisites or a separate report.
accounting.totalsHint: Receipts and refunds use financial event dates. These are not profit. Bookings use creation dates.
accounting.documentHint: Draft service acts and invoices are created after recorded checkout. Reviewed copies can be shared with the guest. These are not signed electronic invoices. A cash order remains a draft: a bank payment is not proof of cash received.
accounting.documentLimit: Showing the first 200 documents. Narrow the period to find others.
accounting.companyHint: Enter verified company details and the applicable tax treatment. Publishing freezes the document. Signatures, digital signing and official electronic invoice registration are separate.
accounting.guestHint: Prepared documents appear after the stay and accountant review.
accounting.demoHint: Document preparation and downloads require the Django API.
accounting.fileReady: File ready. If the download did not start, select Download.
accounting.copyHint: A prepared template copy without signatures, digital signing or registration in the electronic invoice system.
accounting.guestEmpty: No documents have been issued yet. After checkout, the accountant reviews the details and issues copies here.
accounting.staffDocumentsHint: View documents for this booking. An accountant or administrator handles changes and guest issuance.
accounting.staffDocumentsEmpty: No documents prepared yet. The act and invoice are drafted after recorded checkout.

children.invalidIin: Enter the child’s 12-digit IIN. The first six digits must represent a valid past date, with an age under 18 at check-in.
children.hint: The demo estimates age from the first six digits. The full IIN is neither sent to the server nor stored. This is not identity verification; discounts depend on the rate.
children.partySizeHint: Children are included in the total guest count. Adding a child increases the total when needed; at least one adult is required.

finance.title: Platform finances
finance.basis: Online receipts and refunds use transaction dates; accommodation, outstanding onsite balances and staff payment records use selected orders (creation date). Staff records are excluded from platform receipts. Expenses use incurred dates; commission is an estimate before refund reconciliation. This is not a bank balance or net profit.
finance.confirmedAmount: Accommodation in confirmed orders, excluding fees
finance.expenseHint: Manual record of incurred expenses in whole KZT. This does not make a payment. Mistakes can be voided with a reason; history is retained.
finance.limit: Results are limited. Narrow the period or select a property.

catalogContent.descriptionAfterHelp: Optional. This text appears below the gallery.
catalogContent.optionalPublicContact: Optional. This number will be visible to guests.

settlement.feeHelp: Pay the indicated amount now and the rest at the resort. Both amounts are already included in the total price.
settlement.notConfigured: Online booking for this resort is not available yet.

voucher.title: Booking confirmation
voucher.explanation: Show this voucher to the sanatorium staff. It confirms the booking and shows online and on-site payments separately. It is not a bank or fiscal receipt.
voucher.fileReady: Your PDF is ready to download or open.
voucher.recordDates: Record payment only during the stay, before the guest checks out.
voucher.receivedConfirmation: I confirm the sanatorium received {amount} from this guest.
voucher.recordHint: This records money actually received by the sanatorium. It does not charge a card, transfer funds or issue a bank receipt.

documentGuests.title: Guest details for documents
documentGuests.hint: Enter guest details for the invoice, service act and cash order. Customers do not enter these details during booking.
documentGuests.requiredHint: Issuing documents requires each guest’s full name and IIN, a selected payer and the payer’s address. Incomplete details can be saved as a draft.
documentGuests.demoUnavailable: These details are not saved in demo mode. Enter them only in the connected staff workspace.
documentGuests.savedDocumentHint: Changes apply to new and refreshed drafts. Documents already issued stay unchanged.
documentGuests.conflict: Another staff member changed these details. Your input remains on screen. Load the current version before saving again.
documentGuests.invalidBuyer: Select a payer from the guest list.
documentGuests.tooLong: Check the field lengths for guest {number}.
documentGuests.invalidIin: Guest {number}: IIN must contain exactly 12 digits.
documentGuests.invalidIban: Guest {number}: IBAN must start with KZ followed by 18 letters or digits.
documentGuests.invalidBik: Guest {number}: BIC must contain 8 or 11 letters or digits.
